dialogues.speaker: Aybak
dialogues.text: ...Ah, please don't get me wrong. Safie isn't my real sister, it's because we're a very close-knit group, so we call each other brother and sister.

dialogues.speaker: Aybak
dialogues.text: Our group just received a few new commissions, and one of them really suits her. But she's nowhere to be found... I guess she wandered off somewhere again.
